definitions.explanation: A person whose job is to deliver packages, food, mail, or other items to homes and businesses.

examples.japanese: {配達員|はいたついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}けて→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The delivery person brought the package.

examples.japanese: ⟦フード→フード：28535_fuudo⟧⟦デリバリー→デリバリー：06181_deribarii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配達員|はいたついん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I'm working as a food delivery courier.

examples.japanese: {配達員|はいたついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{受|う}け{取|と}り⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おいて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm the pickup location before the delivery person arrives.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧ (delivery) + {員|いん} (member, worker). A common term that has become increasingly frequent with the growth of online shopping and food delivery services.

USAGE:
Used for all types of delivery workers — package couriers, mail carriers, newspaper deliverers, and food delivery riders. With the rise of services like Uber Eats and {出前館|でまえかん}, the word has become even more common in daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配達員|はいたついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ — a delivery person delivers
- {配達員|はいたついん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ — to call a delivery person
- ⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧{配達員|はいたついん} — home delivery courier
- ⟦フード→フード：28535_fuudo⟧⟦デリバリー→デリバリー：06181_deribarii⟧{配達員|はいたついん} — food delivery worker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {配達人|はいたつにん} — delivery person (slightly more old-fashioned variant)
- ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧⟦ドライバー→ドライバー：05478_doraibaa⟧ — parcel delivery driver
- {郵便配達|ゆうびんはいたつ} — mail delivery (the service, not the person)
